rules.description: Flag flavin_dehydrogenase_reductase rows whose mechanism text contains di-iron, non-heme, Fe-S, iron-sulfur, radical, semiquinone, covalent FAD/flavin, or related signals. This preserves clean hydride-transfer rows but shortlists mixed radical/metal chemistry for expert review.
Flag ser_his_acid_hydrolase rows whose mechanism text has Cys/cysteine/thiolate/cysteine-protease nucleophile signals.
Flag heme_peroxidase_oxidase rows whose text includes non-heme or mixed-metal oxidase signals such as copper, manganese, molybdenum, pterin, di-iron, or non-heme wording.
Flag PLP, cobalamin, or radical-SAM rows whose text contains a coupled non-headline cofactor/radical signal.

scope: Cheap deterministic mechanism-text/fingerprint mismatch scan over the 210 bronze rows carrying label_factory_review_import provenance in the current 702-label registry. The scan preserves signal and never relabels automatically.
